description: Search clinical trials authorised in the EU/EEA under Regulation 536/2014, from the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS). Filter by medicine or active substance, medical condition, sponsor, trial status, phase, member state, age group, sex, results availability and start date. Returns trial number, title, status, sponsor, phase, conditions, products, per-country status, enrolment and primary endpoint. Answers questions such as which European trials are recruiting for a drug, who sponsors them and which member states they run in.

age_group.description: Age range of subjects: "in utero", "0-17 years", "18-64 years", "65+ years"

country.description: EEA member states concerned, by name or ISO code, e.g. ["Germany", "ES"]

endpoint.description: Words appearing in the trial endpoints

exclude.description: Terms that must NOT appear in the record

gender.description: Restrict to trials enrolling "male" or "female" subjects

has_results.description: Only trials that have posted study results

medicine.description: Medicine, brand or active substance name, e.g. "pembrolizumab"

orphan_designation.description: Only trials of a product with an orphan designation

phase.description: Trial phase — "1", "2", "3", "4" (or "phase III"), which expands to the integrated phases too

query.description: Free-text terms matched across the trial record (any of the words)

rare_disease.description: Only trials in a rare disease

region.description: Where the trial runs: "EEA only", "non-EEA only" or "both"

sort_by.description: Sort field: decisionDate (default), ctNumber, sponsor, ctStatus

status.description: Trial status: "Under evaluation", "Authorised, recruitment pending", "Authorised, recruiting", "Ongoing, recruiting", "Ongoing, recruitment ended", "Temporarily halted", "Suspended", "Ended", "Expired", "Revoked", "Not authorised", "Cancelled"

title.description: Words that must appear in the trial title

name: ctis_search_trials
title: Ctis Search Trials
